reviews.summary: This exact pi-t r3 source uses CUDA events, not chrono-only timing: main records the start event at host address 0xca77, enters the timed launch loop at 0xd4a0 when local rows and iterations are nonzero, calls `spmvCuda` at 0xd4c3 (function entry 0xe860), increments ebx at 0xd4ce, compares it to the runtime iteration count at 0xd4d0, and branches back to loop entry 0xca94 at 0xd4d2. It then records the stop event at 0xcaad and synchronizes it at 0xcb07. `spmvCuda` configures one block per local row with 256 threads, passes the kernel entry 0xe5b0 to CUDA launch runtime at 0xea42–0xea44, and checks launch status. The sm_86 kernel bounds blockIdx.x by localDim; threads stride through the complete row length by blockDim.x, multiply and accumulate each CSR value/vector entry, reduce in shared memory, and thread 0 stores the row output.
